note: the design proposal/hash-map-lend.md built as written with six recorded deviations; merged into next 26257f20

closes.text: LOCATED in the store's KEYED step, not the variant reader: `Store<HashMap>::at(key)` read `held.get(key)`, a by-value copy (two deep clones on JS - the (K, V) pair, then the value); every other step lent in place. Fixed by lending the map's slot: `vilan_rt::Map`'s tombstone moved onto the value (`Vec<(K, Option<V>)>`) so a present entry's value is a real `&Option<V>`; `NativeMap::lend`/`lend_mut` (intrinsics `MapLend`/`MapLendMut` on the JS, native and interpreter backends, no `__clone`); `HashMap` on two tables (`keys` + `values`, one insertion order) with `peek`/`modify`; the store's `at` twins lend through them, and the native `some()` readers match through `&`. The item's repro, 2,000 title reads: node 10.66 / 30.2 / 240 ms -> 7.1 / 3.2 / 2.8 ms (the integrator re-measured 11 / 3.3 / 3.8); native 9 / 109 / 968 -> 6 / 6 / 7 ms. Pins: std_surface (peek/modify/update semantics, insertion order, remove-on-None, the codegen-shape pin that the keyed step carries no `__clone`), three `vilan_rt::Map` units, the native differential `hash_map_lend.vl`. Also fixed on the way: `NativeMap::insert` takes `own value`, closing a JS aliasing bug in `HashSet` (its own CHANGELOG miscompile entry). 20 corpus goldens moved by the map's new shape (read, then regenerated); perf bump rows for math and watch (x1.007). The dbg/DAP map layout is `keys`/`values` (vscode printer.ts + its test). Finds B691 (JS enum copy miscompile), B692, F155; follow-ups M183, M184. Kolt copy checks clean under the lane's binary.

`HashMap::peek(key, |&Option<V>| U)` reads the slot in place, `modify(key, |&mut Option<V>| U)` writes it in place (`None` left = the key removed; `Some` under an absent key = inserted last; a present key keeps its place), and `update(key, lazy missing: V, change: |&mut V| void)` is the grouping idiom - `groups.update(key, [], |list| list.push(row))` - at O(1) per push: the item's repro 1k/4k/16k pushes 10.7 / 127 / 2274 ms as written -> 0.8 / 2.2 / 5.4 ms on `update` (native 0 / 3 / 11). `missing` is `lazy` (the ratified spelling, proposal/lazy.md) rather than the item's `|| V`; `get` is one copy instead of two. Docs: std/collections.md (the three methods, 'Reading and writing in place'), std/store.md. `List::group_by` not built. Owner Qs 1-3 in hash-map-lend.md §7 (names; lazy; two tables).
